## Activity

During February 2022, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 332 captures. Activity proceeded as planned, with session lists managed through the month. Routine leave was accommodated without affecting the reported activity.

The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the period. The site’s results are set out below in relation to the number of images captured, the proportion that could not be graded, and the number of referable results.

## Image quality

Of the 332 captures, 14 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.2 per cent. The result should be monitored through routine site review, with attention to maintaining consistent image capture and supporting staff practice where required.

## Grading

A total of 76 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 15 days. Together, these measures provide an overview of grading workload and timeliness for February 2022. The reported lag should continue to be reviewed alongside activity levels and image quality to support timely completion of grading and appropriate follow-up of referable results.
